# Python execution acceptance

```{python}
import os
from pathlib import Path
from ipykernel.connect import get_connection_file
from IPython.display import display
assert 'total' not in globals()
Path('process.txt').write_text(f'{os.getpid()}\n{get_connection_file()}\n')
with Path('runs.txt').open('a') as runs:
    runs.write('executed\n')
total = sum([2, 4, 6])
```

```{python}
import sys
print(f'total = {total}', flush=True)
print('intentional stderr', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
display({'text/html': '<strong>safe html</strong>', 'text/plain': 'html fallback'}, raw=True)
display({'text/markdown': '**total:** `12`', 'text/plain': 'markdown fallback'}, raw=True)
display({'image/svg+xml': '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="20">12</text></svg>', 'text/plain': 'figure fallback'}, raw=True)
```

```{python}
display({'application/javascript': 'rejected payload'}, raw=True)
display({'application/javascript': 'rejected payload', 'text/plain': 'safe fallback'}, raw=True)
```

```{python}
#| error: true
raise ValueError('allowed error')
```

```{python}
assert total == 12
print('state survived the error')
```
